senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. חמי) [pressed, thick,] cream or butter.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 63b:17">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 30:33">Prov. XXX, 33</cite>) <he>ח׳ של תורה</he> the cream of the Law (sound knowledge).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86b:15">B. Mets. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>בשכר ח׳ וכ׳</he> as a reward for the offer of cream and milk (<cite ref="Genesis 18:8">Gen. XVIII, 8</cite>).
